newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen steady.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.03 down at 41.33 rupees to the dollar in the kerb market on Monday amid high demand for the U.S. currency, but dealers said the rupee might open steady on Tuesday.
One dealer said dollar supply was likely to outpace demand and keep the rupee stable on Tuesday.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on April 23, was 40.2400/40.4412 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 2.70 percent.
